input.scope: already-inspected development bank; exploratory mechanism evidence only

coded_verification.critical_global_obligation: distribution-free [0,1] box lower bound on aggregate trusted gain

information_budget.effective_dimension: number of fixed task probe strata = 12

interpretation: compare resolution, harmful-proposal allowance, and allowance of proposals with more than the coded local-regression budget; do not convert this already-inspected development bank into confirmatory evidence
limitations: development tasks and candidate bank were inspected before this replay was designed
public-score optimization is frozen-bank reweighting, not a neural weight update
fixed task probes are an engineering coverage basis, not a theorem-level universal hitting set
coded local violations are an engineering analogue of robust local constraints, not PCP-for-PPAD
d*log(1/epsilon) is a heuristic budget proxy, not an LLM lower bound
trusted_score is offline finite-domain correctness and does not represent unrestricted code correctness
